principle: Use the 2026-09-28 SLBFE/HRD Korea point-system notice for current Manufacturing exact facts. Do not reuse the completed 10th Point System as the current recruitment cycle.

primaryNotice.title: Notice on the Implementation of the Point-Based Selection System for Foreign Workers

answers.question: What is the scheduled Manufacturing quota?
answers.writeExactly: Current Manufacturing quota: 1,000.

answers.question: When is the application period?
answers.writeExactly: Apply through SLBFE during 2026-10-26 through 2026-10-30, subject to official instructions.

answers.question: When will SLBFE publish application-completion instructions?
answers.writeExactly: Check SLBFE on 2026-10-12 for application-completion instructions before submitting.

answers.question: What is the application fee?
answers.writeExactly: Official fee: US$28 / LKR 9,250 under the current notice.

answers.question: What age range applies?
answers.writeExactly: Current age rule: 18–39, DOB 1986-10-27 through 2008-10-26.

answers.question: What criminal-history rule applies?
answers.answer: No criminal record of imprisonment or heavier legal punishment.
answers.writeExactly: Applicant must satisfy the current criminal-history condition.

answers.question: What Korea departure-history rule applies?
answers.answer: No history of forced deportation or departure from Korea.
answers.writeExactly: Applicant must have no forced deportation/departure history from Korea.

answers.question: Can a person with a travel-ban reason apply?
answers.writeExactly: Applicant must have no reason for a travel ban.

answers.question: What color-vision rule applies?
answers.answer: No color blindness or color weakness.
answers.writeExactly: Color blindness or color weakness is ineligible.

answers.question: What prior Korea stay limit applies?
answers.answer: No experience of staying in Korea for five years or longer under E-9 or E-10, with the notice noting a six-year exception context for certain legally extended employment activity.
answers.writeExactly: Use the exact current E-9/E-10 stay rule from the notice; ordinary eligibility requires less than five years.

answers.question: Can an applicant select more than one industry?
answers.answer: No. Select one industry only; it cannot be changed after passing Round 1.
answers.writeExactly: Choose one industry only; after Round 1 pass, it cannot be changed.

answers.question: What passport scan requirements are stated?
answers.answer: One passport copy/file; key identity data must match, file width 600 px and 100 KB or less; passport valid at least 3 months from application date.
answers.writeExactly: Make passport identity data match the application; use the current 600 px / ≤100 KB requirement and ensure at least 3 months validity from application.

answers.question: What photo file requirements are stated?
answers.answer: 3.5×4.5 cm, white background, taken within 6 months, JPG ≤15 KB, 100–300 pixels.
answers.writeExactly: Use a recent white-background 3.5×4.5 cm JPG, ≤15 KB, 100–300 px.

answers.question: When will test requirements/date and venue be announced?
answers.writeExactly: Check SLBFE on/after 2026-11-16 for the official test requirements and individual schedule.

answers.question: When does the UBT period begin?
answers.answer: November 25, 2026, with the broader period extending into March 2027 subject to change.
answers.writeExactly: UBT begins 2026-11-25; individual dates come from SLBFE and the overall period may change.

answers.question: What is the EPS-TOPIK format?
answers.answer: 40 multiple-choice questions: 20 reading + 20 listening, 50 minutes total.
answers.writeExactly: Round 1: 20 reading + 20 listening = 40 questions / 50 minutes.

answers.question: What is included in the mandatory Skills Test?
answers.answer: Physical fitness (hand/back strength), interview and basic skills test; optional Job Capacity Assessment can add points for verified work experience/training/education/qualifications.
answers.writeExactly: Round 2 is mandatory; job-capacity documents can add points if verified.

answers.question: What happens below 60% on the Skills Test?
answers.answer: Applicants scoring below 60% of the Skills Test maximum are screened out.
answers.writeExactly: Skills Test score below 60% of maximum fails the screening rule.

answers.question: What happens if submitted documents are false?
answers.answer: Results are nullified and the applicant is barred from applying to EPS for four years, with possible legal action.
answers.writeExactly: Do not submit false documents; the current notice provides for nullification, a four-year EPS ban and possible legal action.

answers.question: Does final success or roster inclusion guarantee a job?
answers.writeExactly: Job-seekers roster eligibility does not guarantee employment in Korea.
